description:
List journal entries.

``period_ids`` narrows to specific fiscal periods, and is how a caller asks for
**one fiscal year**: the year's period ids (ZET-285). Without it the route lists every
fiscal year. ``total`` is the filtered total.

``untagged_subledger_control=true`` narrows to the entries that posted to an
AR/AP control account **without** touching the subledger, under
``allow_untagged_control`` (ZET-150) — the postings a subledger-vs-control
divergence traces back to.

``origin``: one entry origin (ZEN-42). ``account_id``: entries with a line on it;
``date_from``/``date_to``: posting date; ``amount_min``/``amount_max``: the entry total.
name: list_gl_journal_entries
